Commentary.Commentary: Right then, this series has been a roller-coaster of a ride so far. The scoreline is now 2-2 and all roads will now head to Bengaluru on Sunday, 19th of June. It promises to be one cracker of a decider. The game will begin at 7 pm IST (1.30 pm GMT). However, as you know our build-up will begin well in advance. So do join us for the same. Till then, goodbye and cheers!

Dinesh Karthik is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for his brilliant knock of 55 from just 27 balls. He says it feels good to be playing for a long time and he is getting used to this new setup as a player as he has been on the other side of the mic for a few months and he is getting used to this new role, as he has played cricket for so long that he is being interviewed by people whom he had played against. Adds that he feels secure in this Indian setup and there is comfort in the dressing room. There are a few goals and he wants to achieve it. Shares that he is thinking and assessing much better now, there is a lot of hard work behind the scenes. Tells that South Africa bowled brilliantly up front, they were finding it hard to bat and when he went in, Pandya told him to take time before hitting big. Tells that he feels like a local boy at Bangalore as he has played in the domestic team and hopes to perform well in the final match. Says it is good to see a bilateral series going down to the final match. To see the pressure being absorbed in the third and fourth games is what they will relish. Credits Rahul Dravid and says, he has clarity and calmness even when they don't do well and feels they need to embrace pressure.

Rishabh Pant, the skipper of India, says that they talked about execution and playing good cricket and here are the results. Tells that they can talk about toss but it is the team that plays well that wins the game. Tells that he is very happy with how Hardik played and Dinesh Karthik going for a kill from the start and that partnership was great for them. Mentions that he can improve as an individual on various fronts but he is not thinking too much of it and is just trying to improve. Signs off by saying that he is looking forward to the final game in Bengaluru.

The South African skipper is injured and Keshav Maharaj comes in for a chat in place of Temba Bavuma. He says it didn't go according to the plan as they leaked too many runs in the last five overs. Adds that they have to adapt better and have to be proactive in this kind of pitch and situation. Tells they lost wickets at regular intervals. Dinesh Karthik was exceptional in the back end and he hopes to come back stronger in the last match. Ends by saying, it is always hard to bowl on the Indian pitch. Tells that there will be a lot of buzz at the ground in Bangalore and expects it to be a cracker.
Stay tuned for the Presentation.

Avesh Khan is down for a chat. He says it is his dad's birthday so he dedicates this win to him. The plan was to bowl stump to stump as the pitch was two-paced, so he was bowling on a length. Adds that Pant said to him to bowl a leg-cutter after bowling a bouncer and bowled to Jansen and a slower one to Maharaj. Tells that as a team, they need to back themselves and will now focus on the next match. Shares that they will give 100% in the next match.

The difference though as mentioned earlier was the innings of a man who is on a comeback mission in the Indian team, Dinesh Karthik. We saw in the Indian T20 League what he did for Bangalore in those death overs and now he has done that again in the Indian blue, he smashed 55 from 27 balls and Hardik also gave him good company with a well-paced innings of 46. South African bowlers were good till the 15th over but that onslaught by India in the final five overs where they scored 73 runs took the game away from them on a tricky Rajkot pitch. South Africa need to regroup and come out with better plans and execution in the decider now, it will be more of a mental battle for them.

Indian bowlers came out with a plan as they assessed the nature of the pitch after that first innings and bowled hard lengths. South African batters struggled to get going and Bavuma got injured early in his innings. Quinton de Kock departed in the fifth over and from thereon, wickets kept tumbling at regular intervals. Pant also used his bowlers quite well in the middle and Chahal was exceptional with his crafty leg spin again. Harshal Patel knocked over Miller in the 11th over and that buried any hopes that South Africa had of chasing down this total. The icing on the cake was the 14th over by Avesh Khan in which he took three wickets and made sure that India seal the deal with a big win. A brilliant bowling performance from India and it has been a show of great character by this young Indian team.

India level the series here at Rajkot and we are going into Bengaluru now for an all-important decider. Has to say, India have momentum on their side now, it has been another convincing victory for them. This pitch was quite tricky and South Africa had no answers in front of a disciplined bowling performance from the Indian side. However, one man stands out above all here, Dinesh Karthik, his knock was a game-changer on a pitch where every other batter struggled to get going and after two back-to-back losses in the first two games, India have roared back in style in this series.

OUT! TAKEN! Hand shakes all-around as that will be the end of South Africa's innings as Temba Bavuma won't be able to play! Tossed up on middle. Lungi Ngidi lofts it to long on where Ruturaj Gaikwad takes it. India level the series 2-2 as they win by 82 runs.
Commentary.Howout: c Ruturaj Gaikwad b Axar Patel

Commentary.Commentary: On middle, blocked out.
Slightly shorter and just outside off. Ngidi looks to pull but misses. Was very near to the off pole.
Angles again on middle, tucked to square leg for a single.
Slants a length ball, around off. Shamsi hits it to point.
Axar Patel is back on.
Length ball, outside off. Ngidi strokes it to sweeper cover for a brace.
Another bumper and Ngidi leaves it out. Khan should go for a fuller ball.
A length ball, around off. Ngidi mistimes his punch to covers.
A bouncer on the slower side, on middle. Ngidi sits under it.
Three runs! A length ball, way outside off. Shamsi frees his arms and places it over covers. The batters take three runs.
On a length and outside off. Ngidi dabs it to third man for a single.
Tabraiz Shamsi could be the last man in, anticipating Bavuma won't be able to come back.

OUT! CAUGHT! Here we go...Chahal outfoxes another batter with a clever delivery! Tossed up, outside off. Anrich Nortje goes for a big swing across the line. He miscues it completely and the gets an outside edge towards point where Ishan Kishan takes an easy catch. 90 needed now from 30 balls and India are looking all set to level this series with a big win here now.
Commentary.Howout: c Ishan Kishan b Yuzvendra Chahal

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up, outside off. Anrich Nortje looks to drive it away but misses.
A googly on middle and leg. Anrich Nortje defends it off the back foot.
This is fuller on off. Ngidi hits it hard back to the bowler and Chahal half-stops it. A single taken.
Tossed up on off. Chahal blocks it out.
A fuller delivery, on off. Anrich Nortje drives it through covers for a single.
Lungi Ngidi comes in now.

OUT! CAUGHT! That extra bounce gives Avesh Khan his third wicket of the over! Khan bowls it short on off. Keshav Maharaj looks to pull it away. However, he is hurried by the pace of the ball and the bounce in it. It hits high on the blade and the ball loops up in the air towards mid on. Shreyas Iyer there takes an easy catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Shreyas Iyer b Avesh Khan

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR BYES! That has taken off again! Shorter delivery, around off. Keshav Maharaj looks to slap it away but misses as the ball rises sharply. Pant behind the stumps jumps to stop the ball but it goes over him to the fence.
Anrich Nortje walks in.

OUT! TAKEN! Another wicket for Avesh Khan and another catch for Ruturaj Gaikwad, South Africa lose their sixth! Khan stays with that shortish length on off. Jansen pulls it this time but does not get the timing he desired for. The ball goes right of the fielder at deep mid-wicket and Ruturaj Gaikwad runs to his right and covers a lot of ground to take a good diving catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Ruturaj Gaikwad b Avesh Khan

Commentary.Commentary: Marco Jansen gets hit on the helmet and needs some assistance. He gets hit on the back of his head. Not a good sight to see. A mandatory concussion protocol going on.
A sharp bouncer on off. Jansen looks to pull it but misses. The ball hits him below his ear. He looks in some pain here.
Temba Bavuma looks worried and it looks like he will not come onto bat in this match. We still wait to find out. Keshav Maharaj is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Rassie van der Dussen departs now and South Africa sink further! Khan with that length delivery, around off. Rassie van der Dussen gets a bit across and heaves it aerially towards deep mid-wicket. He does not get the desired result and Ruturaj Gaikwad in the deep there takes the catch comfortably. South Africa are in all sorts of trouble here!
Commentary.Howout: c Ruturaj Gaikwad b Avesh Khan

Commentary.Commentary: On a length, around off. Jansen guides it towards third man for a single.
Darts this on leg. Jansen works it to short fine leg for a single. Just 3 from the over and South Africa need a big over here, 97 needed from 42 balls!
Nice loopy delivery, outside off. Jansen looks to loft it away towards the off side but misses.
This is fuller on off. Jansen hits it hard but knock down the stumps at the other end. Luckily for Rassie van der Dussen at the bowler's end, Chahal did not get his finger tips on that ball.
A flatter and quicker one, around off. Jansen looks to block it but gets beaten.
WIDE! Chahal goes further wide outside off and Jansen lets it go. Wided!
This is outside off and Jansen tries to reverse-sweep but misses.
Flighted delivery on off. Rassie van der Dussen reverse-sweeps it towards deep backward point for a single.
Beaten! Tossed up, around off. Jansen looks to defend it off the front foot. However, the ball spins away and beats the outside edge of his blade. 100 needed from 48 balls!
FOUR! Axar Patel overcompensates and pays the price. He drags it short on off. Jansen stays back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
SIX! Massive! This is out of the stadium! 104 metres hit that! Tossed up on off. Jansen skips down the track and tonks it over long on for a biggie.
A fuller delivery on off. Jansen drives it to the cover fielder.
Darts it on middle again. Jansen defends it off the front foot. He actually gets the inside edge of his blade onto the turf.
A flatter one on middle. Rassie van der Dussen works it towards the leg side for a single.

Beaten! A very good over for India, just a single and a big wicket! South Africa now need 111 runs from 54 balls! A good-length delivery, outside off. Jansen tries to push it away towards the off side but misses.
A slower full toss on off. Jansen picks it luckily and blocks it.
A fullish delivery on middle at 133.3 kph. Jansen works it towards short mid-wicket.
Back of a length, around off, It nips back in with good bounce and Jansen blocks it out.
Marco Jansen walks out to the middle.

OUT! BOWLED! This is a killer blow as Harshal Patel gets rid of the dangerous 'Killer Miller'! Harshal Patel with that hard length again, on off. Miller tries to work it towards the leg side but misses as the ball knocks over the off pole. Harshal Patel is delighted and rightly so, this now makes India a firm favourite to win this one. The pair of Chahal and Harshal Patel doing the trick again for India!
On a length, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen cuts it left of point towards deep backward point for a single.

DRINKS! Just like the previous game, India have been top-notch with their bowling in these first 10 overs. This is a tricky pitch and South African batters struggled to get going, the run out of Quinton de Kock did not help their cause and it is now upto this pair of Rassie van der Dussen and David Miller to take them over the line, just like they did in the first game. It will be a tough task though on this pitch and let's see how things pan out. South Africa need a Miller special here!
Touch short and on middle. Rassie van der Dussen forces it to deep square leg for a single. 112 needed in 60 balls.
Around off, punched through covers for a single.
A sharp single! Flatter and outside off, it is cut to point and Rassie van der Dussen makes it to the other side on time.
Steep bounce there, shorter and on leg. Miller stays back and tries to defend but plays from the higher part of the blade and to short third man for a single.
Flatter and on off. Miller punches it to covers.
On middle, worked to mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! Massive one! Fuller and outside off. Miller slog-sweeps it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Shorter and on middle, it spins back in. Miller hangs back and chips it back to Chahal who takes it on a bounce.
Fuller and just around off. Rassie van der Dussen turns it to square leg and gets only a single as the fielder is quick to the ball.
Full and on middle, flicked to mid-wicket for a single.
David Miller walks in next.

OUT! LBW! South Africa lose another! Chahal continues from where he left off in the previous game! Chahal slows it up, full and around leg, the ball stays low off the deck. Heinrich Klaasen gets on his knee as he looks to sweep but is too late to his shot and gets rapped on the pads. An appeal for LBW and up goes the finger. Heinrich Klaasen has a word with Rassie van der Dussen and opts to review it. UltraEdge shows no bat. Ball Tracker shows three reds and Heinrich Klaasen has to take the long walk.
FOUR! Good start to the over by Klaasen! Tossed up, wide outside off. Heinrich Klaasen comes down the track and hammers it to long on for a boundary.
Slows it up, too full and on off, pushed through covers for a single.

An arm ball, this one keeps on coming with the angle and bowls around middle and leg. Heinrich Klaasen misses his flick and gets hit on the pads. A huge, huge appeal for LBW but nothing given. Patel wasn't much interested but Pant goes for the review. No bat there. Ball Tracker shows it is umpire's call on wickets hitting. Not out it is.
Flatter and around off, pushed back to Patel.
Tossed up on middle. Rassie van der Dussen steps forward and helps it to short fine leg for a quick single.
Flatter, quicker and on off. Rassie van der Dussen tries to revers-hit it but mistimes it on the off side.
An arm ball, tailing in on middle. Rassie van der Dussen looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
So spin from both ends now. Axar Patel is brought into the attack.
Slower, full and on off. It is hit to mid-wicket for a single.
Slower in the air, full and slanting on leg. Rassie van der Dussen reverse-sweeps again to backward point.
Targets the stumps, pushed to long off for one more.
A loopy ball, on middle and leg. Rassie van der Dussen drills it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up, full and on middle. Rassie van der Dussen reverse-sweeps it to backward point.
Full, slower and on the pads, tucked to deep mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Second one of the over! South Africa end the Powerplay on a high! On a length and on the pads. Rassie van der Dussen flicks it past short fine leg and to deep backward square leg for a boundary. South Africa are 35 for 2 at the end of the sixth over 135 needed in 84 balls.
Bangs a bouncer now, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen lets it alone.
FOUR! Much needed one for the Proteas! Length again, too much width. Rassie van der Dussen cuts it through covers for a boundary.
A length ball, outside off. Heinrich Klaasen cuts it uppishly and to third man for a single.
Heinrich Klaasen is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Khan strikes now! Perfect start for India! Khan hits the hard length, around off, it nips back in and bounces off the deck. Dwaine Pretorius hangs back and has a wild swing across the line but only manages a bottom edge and Rishabh Pant takes it. India bossing the Powerplay.
Commentary.Howout: c Rishabh Pant b Avesh Khan

Commentary.Commentary: Just past! Short of a length, around off and there is extra bounce. Rassie van der Dussen looks to defend but it goes off the shoulder of the bat and lobs past the diving backward point fielder for a single.
Back of a length, around off. Rassie van der Dussen dabs it towards third man for a single.
Rassie van der Dussen comes in.

OUT! RUN OUT! What a terrible mix-up this is and India get a big wicket of Quinton de Kock! On a length, on off. Quinton de Kock looks to defend but gets the inside edge onto his pads. The ball just rolls towards the off side. However, Quinton de Kock initially looks for a run but Dwaine Pretorius is late to react. He then takes some strides forward and Quinton de Kock who is in two minds is strangled in between. In the meanwhile, Harshal Patel senses an opportunity and collects the ball and runs towards the batter's end to whip the bails off. A very disappointing end to Quinton de Kock's innings and India are off to a good start here!
A shortish-length delivery, outside off. Quinton de Kock cuts but finds the fielder at cover-point.
A yorker, around leg at 124.3 kph. Dwaine Pretorius looks to whip it away but gets hit on his pads. A leg bye taken towards the leg side.
Back of a length, on middle at 125.8 kph. Quinton de Kock pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
On a length and angling into middle from 'round the wicket. Quinton de Kock blocks it solidly.
Harshal Patel to bowl now.
Shortish length and outside off again. Dwaine Pretorius cuts but straight to the fielder at point. Just 2 from this over and South Africa need to kick on from here!
Back of a length, outside off. Dwaine Pretorius tries to slash it away but misses.
Good bouncer! Bangs it short and on middle. Dwaine Pretorius sways away from the line of the ball. Pant does well to stop it with one hand.
On a length, on off. Quinton de Kock pushes it to mid off and takes a single.
On a length and angling into leg. Bavuma tries to work it towards the leg side but misses. The ball hits his pads and rolls towards the leg side. A leg bye taken.
Dwaine Pretorius walks out to the middle.

Another halt! Temba Bavuma lands on his left elbow as he dives for a run in the last delivery of the previous over and he is having some issues. The physio is called. He is feeling the pain as the physio rolls the tape over and Bavuma is ready to fight along as he resumes to play. Okay, hang on, as he puts his gloves on. Temba Bavuma decides to walk back.  He heads back straight to the dressing room. Hope he is okay.
Back of a length, on off. Bavuma rides the bounce and blocks it out. He almost drags it back on the stumps.
Avesh Khan is into the attack.
Close! A fuller delivery on middle. Bavuma pushes it to mid on and sets off for a single. Pandya fires a direct hit at the bowler's end but Bavuma makes dives and is well inside the crease.
FOUR! Finally, a shot of authority from Bavuma! Lands on a length, around off. Bavuma punces it and find the gap past point for a boundary this time.
Just over! Back of a length, on off. Bavuma pulls it awkwardly over the mid-wicket fielder and gets two runs.
Halt in play! Temba Bavuma gets hit on the helmet and the Indian players walk across quickly to check on him. He looks fine but a concussion protocol will be followed.
Slightly on the shorter side, on off. Bavuma looks to defend but the ball bounces sharply and hits Bavuma on his helmet grill.
On a length, around off. Bavuma punches it crisply this time towards covers and Shreyas Iyer there dives to his left and stops it.
Beaten! Bhuvneshwar Kumar is all over Bavuma here! Bavuma goes across to a length delivery that is outside off. He tries to work it away towards the leg side but the ball swings away and beats him.
Bavuma is off the mark finally! Back of a length, around off. Bavuma steers it towards third man for a single.
Lands on a length, on off. Quinton de Kock defends it onto the turf and takes a quick single.
On a length, outside off. Quinton de Kock leaves it alone.
Back of a length, outside off. Quinton de Kock cuts it again but this time a squarer third man fielder, Harshal Patel cuts it off. Two more runs.
FOUR! More confident shot this time! Short and wide outside off. Quinton de Kock cuts it off the middle of his blade past point for a boundary.

FOUR! Quinton de Kock greets Hardik Pandya with a boundary! Back of a length, around off. Quinton de Kock tries to cut, it is bit too close and gets a thick outside edge. The ball goes towards the third man fence for a boundary.
Who will bowl from the other side? Hardik Pandya has been given the ball.
Brilliant start from Bhuvneshwar Kumar! A fullish delivery, outside off. Bavuma gets across a bit and looks to defend it but is beaten.
A length delivery that tails back in, on off. Bavuma blocks it off the back foot.
Back of a length and this one comes back in from around off. Extra bounce too and Temba Bavuma gets hit on his gloves as he looks to push at it.
Quinton de Kock is off the mark! A full delivery on the pads. Quinton de Kock flicks it to fine leg for a single.
This is fullish in length and a lot straighter. Quinton de Kock blocks it off the front foot.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar with a lovely outswinger! He lands on a good length and around off. It swings away and beats the outsid edge of Quinton de Kock's blade.
